verdict.rationale: Godot's docs state that import parameters can be changed for several assets at the same time. Beyond that, bulk operations are achievable only by writing your own scripts: EditorScript _run(), the EditorInterface API for loading, saving and editing resources, and headless CLI runs. The evidence never shows a general-purpose batch-edit feature an AI agent could invoke directly. Missing for 10: documented multi-selection or batch editing beyond import settings, a first-party bulk API or MCP endpoint for agents, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
